what_this_is: A PROPOSAL for Joe, not adopted (his instruction of 2026-11-19, D-103). Quantity-only and PROVISIONAL: the design as it stands on 2026-11-18; the plan is a DRAFT and not frozen. The as-built classes (pipeline/analysis/second_number.py, data/frozen/second_number_design.json) are unchanged and remain the record. No price, revenue or bill was read; usability is the quantities file's res_price_usable flag. No estimate is here. The two alternatives of rule 8.3 remain undefined; no scenario is defined here.

inputs.a: the change in dose capped at 25 points as assigned (inventory as built)
inputs.lo_hi: smallest and largest change capped at 25 points over rule 8.1's six histories
inputs.reach: load share above zero, uncapped, in any year of 2008-2010 or 2023-2025 in any of the six histories (as assigned or in any case)
inputs.zero: exact equality, as second_number.classify tests it

class_definitions.no_single_dose: 1. No dose as assigned (a site with no load history reaches it), unless its histories give one common dose, in which case that dose is its dose as assigned and the tests below apply. Out of every run on single doses and named.
class_definitions.no_site_in_reach: 2. No data center load above zero in any year of 2008 to 2010 or 2023 to 2025 in any feasible history (uncapped). Its change is zero because nothing reaches it. Still subject to missing sites (D-46 ruling 6).
class_definitions.settled_zero_change_with_load_in_reach: 3. Load in reach (some history carries load in an endpoint period) and the capped change is zero in every history. Zero exposure change, not zero exposure. Which kind is recorded per history: no load at either endpoint in that history, at or above the cap in every endpoint year, or equal capped averages below the cap.
class_definitions.settled: 4. Not classed above and the capped change differs by less than two points across its histories (hi - lo < 2; exactly 2 is not settled). Sub-labels, attributes and not classes: zero_as_assigned_positive_in_some_case (a == 0 and hi > 0; not a verified zero), positive_in_every_case (lo > 0), other.
class_definitions.uncertain_positive_exposure: 5. Not settled and above zero in every history (lo > 0).
class_definitions.apparent_zero: 6. Not settled, zero as assigned and above zero in some history (a == 0, hi > 0). Not a verified zero.
class_definitions.positive_as_assigned_zero_in_some_case: 7. Not settled, above zero as assigned and zero or below in some history (a > 0, lo <= 0).
class_definitions.other_not_settled: 8. Anything left (for example zero or below as assigned with a negative change in some history and two points or more apart). Exists so the classification is exhaustive.

runs.as_assigned: every class with a dose as assigned (2 to 8)
runs.settled_and_no_site_in_reach_only: classes 2, 3 and 4, each at its dose as assigned
runs.ten_highest_leverage_not_settled_left_ou: classes 5 to 8 are not settled; the ten with the highest leverage in the run as assigned at 25 points are left out
runs.class_1: out of every run on single doses, and named

definitions.caps: classes are computed at the 25-point cap only: second_number.py classes at 25 points only (its classify is called on the capped change), so no 50-point or uncapped classes are given

near_zero_changes_not_exactly_zero.what: utilities with a capped change in some history whose absolute value is above zero and under 1e-9 (a floating-point residue that exact equality would not treat as zero)

no_site_in_reach_with_load_outside_the_e.what: class 2 utilities (no load in any endpoint year in any history) that carry load in some year 2011-2022 in some history; reach is measured at the endpoints only, as the proposal defines it
